# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the learner or repository outcome delivered by this pull request.

## Scope

- Milestone/module:
- Content or automation changed:
- Explicitly out of scope:

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m mkdocs build --strict`
- [ ] Markdown checks pass
- [ ] Internal and external link checks pass
- [ ] Secret scanning passes
- [ ] Examples contain no credentials, account IDs, local paths, or personal data
- [ ] Generated files, caches, virtual environments, and state are excluded
- [ ] Labs document cost, security constraints, validation, and teardown
- [ ] Competency-map status is updated where applicable

## Architecture and content review

- [ ] Primary sources are preferred and have a review date
- [ ] Decisions include alternatives and trade-offs
- [ ] Security, reliability, operations, and cost are addressed
- [ ] Examples were tested or clearly marked as illustrative

## Manual approval

- [ ] At least one reviewer has manually approved this pull request
- [ ] All review comments are resolved before merge to `main`
